contract: Logical product resources require caller-supplied independently admitted v4 digests and exact offline-reconciled distribution bindings. Resolution preserves dataset, revision, path, SHA-256, bytes, source/acquisition/layer, semantic dimension and entity granularity. Reads reuse anonymous public/non-gated verification, byte/time/open-result/cache bounds, explicit exact-digest offline cache behavior and eviction.
boundaries: No live Hub access in tests
No durable local lake or named cache
No DuckDB or Polars engine promotion
No deployment, publication, visibility mutation, credential use or production-readiness claim

contract: Dynamic in-memory receipt binds logical resource, admitted contract digest, object digest/bytes, current exact verified-cache availability, last verified origin/time, contract expiry, max read bytes, cache byte/entry bounds, open-result bound and timeout. Reader cache membership is checked only after expiry cleanup; eviction and insufficient capacity report unavailable.

cache-too-small verified remote read does not claim retention
online transport failure does not fall back to cache
boundary: Receipt is transient process evidence, not durable qualification or authority. No live Hub test, mutation, local durable lake, deployment, publication, engine promotion or production-readiness claim.

findings.finding: Allowed caller labels could attach false semantic dimension or entity granularity to verified bytes.
findings.correction: Require an independently admitted semantic-manifest digest whose exact unique claims bind resource, contract digest, dimension and granularity.

findings.finding: Offline capability was static even for fail-closed policy, insufficient cache capacity, or expired contracts.
findings.correction: Derive capability from contract policy, contract and configured byte budgets, and current expiry; receipts remain the current cache-presence evidence.

negative_controls: forged semantics plus a self-consistent but unadmitted manifest rejected
duplicate-key and extra-field admitted manifests rejected
fail-closed policy, insufficient capacity and expired contracts omit offline capability
boundary: Admission digest is caller-supplied independent authority, not inferred from manifest validity. No live Hub access, mutation, deployment, publication or production-readiness claim.
